gumroad_listing.title: US Nonprofit Database 2026 — 1.94M IRS Tax-Exempt Organizations (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
Every active IRS-recognized tax-exempt organization in the United States — 1,944,049 records sourced directly from the IRS Exempt Organization Business Master File (BMF), the same data that powers Candid/GuideStar ($2,000–$9,500/year). One-time $59 download.

**What's included:**
- EIN (Employer Identification Number)
- Organization name
- Full address (street, city, state, ZIP)
- NTEE code — 3-character mission classification (education, health, arts, environment, religion, etc.)
- 501(c) subsection type — isolate charitable 501(c)(3) vs trade 501(c)(6) orgs instantly
- Ruling year — identify newly formed nonprofits 2020–2026
- Asset amount and income amount (from IRS filing)
- Form 990 revenue
- Deductibility code — confirm tax-deductible donation status
- 31 total columns

**Bonus: State-level sub-files for all 50 states (included as bonus ZIP)**

**Who buys this:**
- Grant writers who need a list of every 501(c)(3) in their state by mission type
- Nonprofit SaaS SDRs (Bloomerang, Blackbaud, Virtuous) prospecting mid-size orgs
- Corporate sponsorship teams filtering by geography and NTEE mission
- Accounting firms identifying nonprofit audit targets by revenue tier
- Healthcare consultants mapping 990-filing nonprofit health systems

**vs. the competition:**
- Candid/GuideStar: $2,000–$9,500/year
- Foundation Directory Online: $1,200+/year
- DonorSearch/iWave: $500–$3,000/month
- DataStructured: $59 one-time

**Data source:** IRS Exempt Organization Business Master File — federally mandated public disclosure, updated monthly, no authentication required.
